rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements .
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
At least 30 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Bioproducts Engineering, Food Engineering, Environmental and Ecological Engineering, Integrated B.S. Bioproducts & Biosystems Eng/M.S. Bioproducts & Biosystems Sci, Eng & Mgmt. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
